Country.evidence_source: As a contribution to the literature, we undertook to develop and investigate the psychometric properties of an Arabic-translated version of the BAS-2 as this had not previously been done. This is a worthwhile endeavor given that the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the location of the present study, has experienced exponential social and economic growth in recent years.

section_summary.extract_value: This introduction describes the development and psychometric evaluation of an Arabic translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) conducted in the United Arab Emirates. The authors expected a one-factor structure for the BAS-2 and predicted convergent validity with body image/pride measures and a negative association between BAS-2 scores and BMI (BMI assessed via self-report). The section frames this work as a single present study and notes the absence of prior BAS-2 research in Arab populations.
